**Edge case 1 — the very first time you open the app, before you've saved anything.**

**Open → http://maker:4001/edge-empty.html**

1. This is what a brand-new user sees. The **To read** tab shows a gentle message: *"No bookmarks yet. Open 'Save a link' above to add your first one,"* and both tab counts show **0**.
2. Click the **"＋ Save a link"** heading to expand it, paste `https://github.com`, let the details fill in, and save. Watch the empty message disappear and your first bookmark appear under **To read**.

I made one choice here worth checking: instead of a blank screen, the empty app **points you to the save action** so it's obvious how to start.

Does that empty-start experience seem right? And when you eventually have **no results for a search**, is showing a simple *"No bookmarks match your search"* message (rather than an empty space) what you'd expect?
